column1: # P5-09 (accordproject/concerto-rust#253): the only edits allowed under
# packages/concerto-core/test/** relax an exact-message assertion to a class
# (or 'it throws') check. One row per changed assertion, tab-separated:
#   file           repo-relative path of the test file
#   test           title of the enclosing it('...') block
#   old_assertion  the assertion before (whitespace is collapsed)
#   new_assertion  the assertion after (whitespace is collapsed)
#   reason         why the message differs (e.g. the Rust engine's wording)
# check-guardrails.mjs rule 1 fails on any test change not listed here, any
# added/deleted/renamed/skipped test and any change that is not an assertion.
# Each row is also listed in its PR (file, test, old, new) for review sign-off.
# rows whose reason starts with 'approved rewrite <decision>:' are APPROVED
# REWRITES, pinned to the exact old/new text of one hunk or line (old '(none)'
# for a pure addition). They cover the 27 lenient-DateTime cases that R1
# rejects (BC-07 b+c), rewritten to assert the rejection and its class. See
